mcqs.question: What is the verified financial outlay / statistical figure associated with 'Union Cabinet approves Clean Plant Programme under Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture with ₹1,765.67 crore outlay' announced by ICAR?
mcqs.question_en: What is the verified financial outlay / statistical figure associated with 'Union Cabinet approves Clean Plant Programme under Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture with ₹1,765.67 crore outlay' announced by ICAR?
mcqs.question_hi: ICAR द्वारा घोषित 'केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल ने एकीकृत बागवानी विकास मिशन के तहत ₹1,765.67 करोड़ के परिव्यय से क्लीन प्लांट प्रोग्राम को मंजूरी दी' से संबंधित सत्यापित वित्तीय परिव्यय / सांख्यिकीय आँकड़ा क्या है?
mcqs.explanation: The Union Cabinet chaired by the Prime Minister approved the Clean Plant Programme (CPP) proposed by the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare with a financial outlay of ₹1,765.67 crore. Implemented by the National Horticulture Board (NHB) and ICAR, it establishes 9 world-class Clean Plant Centers across India to provide virus-free planting material for fruit crops.
mcqs.explanation_en: The Union Cabinet chaired by the Prime Minister approved the Clean Plant Programme (CPP) proposed by the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare with a financial outlay of ₹1,765.67 crore. mcqs.question_en: Consider the following statements regarding 'RBI enhances collateral-free Kisan Credit Card and agricultural loan limit from ₹1.6 lakh to ₹2 lakh per borrower': 1. It is associated with RBI. 2. Its primary implementation focus includes India. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

mcqs.explanation: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) announced the enhancement of the limit for collateral-free agricultural loans, including allied activities, from ₹1.6 lakh to ₹2 lakh per borrower. Banks have been directed to waive collateral security and margin requirements for loans up to ₹2 lakh to cushion small and marginal farmers against rising input costs.

Banks have been directed to waive collateral security and margin requirements for loans up to ₹2 lakh to cushion small and marginal farmers against rising input costs.

mcqs.question_hi: 'उत्तर प्रदेश सरकार ने प्रतिवर्ष 1 लाख युवाओं के लिए ₹1,000 करोड़ के बजट आवंटन से मुख्यमंत्री युवा उद्यमी विकास अभियान शुरू किया' के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए: 1. यह Uttar Pradesh Information Portal से संबंधित है। 2. इसका प्रमुख क्रियान्वयन क्षेत्र Uttar Pradesh से जुड़ा है। उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

mcqs.explanation: The Uttar Pradesh Government notified the Mukhyamantri Yuva Udyami Vikas Abhiyan in Lucknow with an allocation of ₹1,000 crore to finance 1 lakh young entrepreneurs every year (10 lakh over 10 years). Eligible trained youth receive interest-free, collateral-free loans up to ₹5 lakh for micro-enterprises and agro-processing units.

Eligible trained youth receive interest-free, collateral-free loans up to ₹5 lakh for micro-enterprises and agro-processing units.

mcqs.question: Consider the following statements regarding 'ISRO successfully launches EOS-08 Earth Observation Satellite aboard SSLV-D3 from Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota': 1. It is associated with ISRO. 2. Its primary implementation focus includes India. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mcqs.question_en: Consider the following statements regarding 'ISRO successfully launches EOS-08 Earth Observation Satellite aboard SSLV-D3 from Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota': 1. It is associated with ISRO. 2. Its primary implementation focus includes India. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mcqs.question_hi: 'इसरो (ISRO) ने श्रीहरिकोटा के सतीश धवन अंतरिक्ष केंद्र से SSLV-D3 द्वारा EOS-08 पृथ्वी अवलोकन उपग्रह का सफल प्रक्षेपण किया' के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए: 1. यह ISRO से संबंधित है। 2. इसका प्रमुख क्रियान्वयन क्षेत्र India से जुड़ा है। उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
options: Neither 1 nor 2 / न तो 1 और न ही 2
mcqs.explanation: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) completed the third developmental flight SSLV-D3 from Sriharikota, placing the 175.5 kg EOS-08 Earth Observation micro-satellite into a 475 km circular Low Earth Orbit. EOS-08 carries Electro Optical Infrared (EOIR) and GNSS-Reflectometry payloads for soil moisture and flood monitoring.
mcqs.explanation_en: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) completed the third developmental flight SSLV-D3 from Sriharikota, placing the 175.5 kg EOS-08 Earth Observation micro-satellite into a 475 km circular Low Earth Orbit. EOS-08 carries Electro Optical Infrared (EOIR) and GNSS-Reflectometry payloads for soil moisture and flood monitoring.
mcqs.explanation_hi: भारतीय अंतरिक्ष अनुसंधान संगठन (ISRO) ने श्रीहरिकोटा से तीसरी विकासात्मक उड़ान SSLV-D3 को सफलतापूर्वक पूरा करते हुए 175.5 किलोग्राम के EOS-08 पृथ्वी अवलोकन माइक्रो-सैटेलाइट को 475 किमी की वृत्ताकार कक्षा में स्थापित किया। इसमें मृदा नमी और बाढ़ निगरानी के लिए EOIR और GNSS-Reflectometry पेलोड लगे हैं।

mcqs.question: Consider the following statements regarding 'ICAR releases 109 biofortified and climate-resilient crop varieties across 61 field and horticultural crops in New Delhi': 1. It is associated with ICAR. 2. Its primary implementation focus includes New Delhi. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mcqs.question_en: Consider the following statements regarding 'ICAR releases 109 biofortified and climate-resilient crop varieties across 61 field and horticultural crops in New Delhi': 1. It is associated with ICAR. 2. Its primary implementation focus includes New Delhi. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mcqs.question_hi: 'आईसीएआर (ICAR) ने नई दिल्ली में 61 खेत और बागवानी फसलों की 109 बायोफोर्टिफाइड और जलवायु-अनुकूली किस्में जारी कीं' के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए: 1. यह ICAR से संबंधित है। 2. इसका प्रमुख क्रियान्वयन क्षेत्र New Delhi से जुड़ा है। उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
options: Neither 1 nor 2 / न तो 1 और न ही 2
mcqs.explanation: The Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) released 109 high-yielding, climate-resilient, and biofortified seed varieties covering 61 crops in New Delhi, including 34 field crops (cereals, millets, pulses, oilseeds) and 27 horticultural crops rich in zinc, iron, and protein.
mcqs.explanation_en: The Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) released 109 high-yielding, climate-resilient, and biofortified seed varieties covering 61 crops in New Delhi, including 34 field crops (cereals, millets, pulses, oilseeds) and 27 horticultural crops rich in zinc, iron, and protein.
mcqs.explanation_hi: भारतीय कृषि अनुसंधान परिषद (ICAR) ने नई दिल्ली में 61 फसलों की 109 उच्च उपज वाली, जलवायु-सहिष्णु और बायोफोर्टिफाइड किस्में जारी कीं, जिनमें 34 खेत की फसलें (अनाज, श्री अन्न, दलहन, तिलहन) और 27 बागवानी फसलें शामिल हैं।
mcqs.exam_category: IBPS AFO / NABARD / UPSSSC AGTA / UPSC

mcqs.question: What is the verified financial outlay / statistical figure associated with 'Ministry of Environment notifies 3 new Ramsar Sites in Tamil Nadu and Madhya Pradesh, taking India tally to 85 wetlands' announced by Ministry of Environment?
mcqs.question_en: What is the verified financial outlay / statistical figure associated with 'Ministry of Environment notifies 3 new Ramsar Sites in Tamil Nadu and Madhya Pradesh, taking India tally to 85 wetlands' announced by Ministry of Environment?
mcqs.question_hi: Ministry of Environment द्वारा घोषित 'पर्यावरण मंत्रालय (MoEFCC) ने तमिलनाडु और मध्य प्रदेश में 3 नए रामसर स्थल अधिसूचित किए, भारत में कुल संख्या 85 हुई' से संबंधित सत्यापित वित्तीय परिव्यय / सांख्यिकीय आँकड़ा क्या है?
mcqs.explanation: The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) designated Nanjarayan Bird Sanctuary and Kazhuveli Bird Sanctuary in Tamil Nadu alongside Tawa Reservoir in Madhya Pradesh as Ramsar Sites of International Importance, expanding India's network to 85 sites covering 13,58,068 hectares.
mcqs.explanation_en: The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) designated Nanjarayan Bird Sanctuary and Kazhuveli Bird Sanctuary in Tamil Nadu alongside Tawa Reservoir in Madhya Pradesh as Ramsar Sites of International Importance, expanding India's network to 85 sites covering 13,58,068 hectares.
mcqs.explanation_hi: पर्यावरण, वन और जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्रालय (MoEFCC) ने तमिलनाडु के नंजरायन पक्षी अभयारण्य और काझुवेली पक्षी अभयारण्य तथा मध्य प्रदेश के तवा जलाशय को अंतर्राष्ट्रीय महत्व के रामसर स्थल के रूप में नामित किया, जिससे भारत में कुल रामसर स्थलों की संख्या 85 (13,58,068 हेक्टेयर) हो गई है।

mcqs.explanation: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) conducted the maiden flight-test of the Long Range Land Attack Cruise Missile (LRLACM) with a range of 1,000 km from a mobile articulated launcher at the Integrated Test Range (ITR), Chandipur off the coast of Odisha, developed by Aeronautical Development Establishment (ADE), Bengaluru.
mcqs.explanation_en: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) conducted the maiden flight-test of the Long Range Land Attack Cruise Missile (LRLACM) with a range of 1,000 km from a mobile articulated launcher at the Integrated Test Range (ITR), Chandipur off the coast of Odisha, developed by Aeronautical Development Establishment (ADE), Bengaluru.
mcqs.explanation_hi: रक्षा अनुसंधान एवं विकास संगठन (DRDO) ने ओडिशा के चांदीपुर स्थित एकीकृत परीक्षण रेंज (ITR) से 1,000 किमी की मारक क्षमता वाली लॉन्ग रेंज लैंड अटैक क्रूज मिसाइल (LRLACM) का मोबाइल आर्टिकुलेटेड लॉन्चर से सफल प्रथम उड़ान परीक्षण किया। इसे बेंगलुरु की एयरोनॉटिकल डेवलपमेंट एस्टैब्लिशमेंट (ADE) ने विकसित किया है।

mcqs.question: Which institution / ministry is the nodal authority behind the verified development 'FAO releases Global Food Outlook 2026 projecting India rice production at record 138 million tonnes and improved global cereal stocks'?
mcqs.question_en: Which institution / ministry is the nodal authority behind the verified development 'FAO releases Global Food Outlook 2026 projecting India rice production at record 138 million tonnes and improved global cereal stocks'?
mcqs.question_hi: सत्यापित विकास 'एफएओ (FAO) ने ग्लोबल फूड आउटलुक 2026 रिपोर्ट जारी की; भारत का चावल उत्पादन रिकॉर्ड 138 मिलियन टन रहने का अनुमान' के पीछे नोडल प्राधिकरण / मंत्रालय कौन-सा है?
options: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / कृषि एवं किसान कल्याण मंत्रालय
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) / भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक (RBI)
mcqs.explanation: The Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) of the United Nations published its biannual Food Outlook report in Rome, projecting global cereal utilization at 2,853 million tonnes and highlighting India's record rice harvest of 138 million tonnes alongside expanded public foodgrain buffer stocks.
mcqs.explanation_en: The Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) of the United Nations published its biannual Food Outlook report in Rome, projecting global cereal utilization at 2,853 million tonnes and highlighting India's record rice harvest of 138 million tonnes alongside expanded public foodgrain buffer stocks.
mcqs.explanation_hi: संयुक्त राष्ट्र के खाद्य और कृषि संगठन (FAO) ने रोम में अपनी द्विवार्षिक 'फूड आउटलुक' रिपोर्ट प्रकाशित की, जिसमें वैश्विक अनाज उपयोग 2,853 मिलियन टन रहने का अनुमान लगाया गया है और भारत के रिकॉर्ड 138 मिलियन टन चावल उत्पादन को रेखांकित किया गया है।
